title: JWT Authentication
definition: JSON Web Tokens (JWT) are a stateless authentication mechanism. Instead of storing sessions in a database, the server cryptographically signs a JSON payload containing the user's ID and sends it to the client. The client sends it back via the `Authorization` header on future requests.
simpleExplanation: JSON Web Tokens (JWT) are a stateless authentication mechanism.

answers.question: When should you avoid using JWT Authentication?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
